name: Small Steps
tagline: A gentle, guided route from curiosity to contact.
typography: Arial / Helvetica contemporary hero and UI paired with Georgia italic and section headings.
rationale: A numbered visual journey reduces navigation effort by organising the decision into approach, person, logistics, and inquiry. It describes site exploration, not a prescribed therapeutic sequence.
mobile: Hero stacks, section navigation wraps two-by-two, slim timeline remains beside content, contact panel keeps clear two-column essentials.
supporting: Profile and verified registration, approach detail, services/fees/access/inquiry FAQ.
trust: Predictable information order gives uncertain visitors a manageable way to explore. Low-pressure language avoids implying therapy must progress in a straight line.
seo: All four sections are visible HTML and indexable in a production version. Add actual service landing pages as warranted; do not hide core content behind an interactive wizard.
tradeoff: A stepped metaphor may imply linear progress if written carelessly. Keep it explicitly about exploring the website, and offer direct navigation to every section.
accessibility: The numbered sequence is optional: navigation permits direct access to practical details and contact. The vertical line is decorative. All sections must remain understandable without animation or colour.
